lua_memory_test.provenance: fceux11-lua | 2026-07-30 demoted to advisory: fceux11_lua_runner lacks full memory binding implementation; Lua-side libs work in standalone test, runner-side binding missing. Tracked as 'unimplemented-coverage' — not a regression, never passed. 2026-08-05 Phase 4.1: bindings verified complete; root cause of round-trip failure = runner initializes the CPU bus memory tables only when a ROM is loaded, so writebyte() was a no-op (BNull) without --rom. Fix: add --rom tests/fixtures/mapper_nrom.nes (git-tracked, available on CI). Re-enabled as blocking.

lua_joypad_test.description: Lua joypad library: get/set with mask1/mask2 override logic
lua_joypad_test.provenance: fceux11-lua | 2026-07-30 demoted to advisory: fceux11_lua_runner does not surface joypad.get/joypad.set to Lua state (mask1/mask2 override logic unimplemented in Rust bindings). 2026-08-05 Phase 4.1: bindings verified present; root cause of failure = joypad.get() returned a TABLE (bitmask_to_table) while the FCEUX-compatible contract (and the test script's first assertion) requires a NUMBER bitmask. Fixed in src/rust/crates/fceux11-lua/bindings/joypad.rs (return state as i32). Re-enabled as blocking.
